name: Inverse Volume Rendering with Recursive Grids
aliases: Volumetric Reconstruction and Interactive Rendering of Trees from Photographs
Volumetric Tree Rendering with Recursive Grid and View-Dependent Texturing
definition: A method to capture and render real trees from a small number of calibrated photographs by estimating opacity on a recursive grid and rendering billboards with view-dependent textures, solving the problem of high geometric complexity and semi-transparency in sparse foliage.
